highlights.title: Six in seven journalist murders go unpunished,  UNESCO reports
highlights.summary: Global impunity for journalist killings has risen for the first time in more than a decade, while the growing use of drones is an emerging threat for reporters in conflict zones, according to the latest report from UN cultural organization UNESCO.

highlights.title: Up in the Clouds With the Pope, It’s Still Commercial
highlights.summary: Unlike American presidents, Pope Leo XIV has no private jet, so he travels on commercial airlines, like the rest of us. Well, almost.

highlights.title: BBC entra na Faixa de Gaza: campos infestados de ratos e feridas que não cicatrizam
highlights.summary: Palestinos relatam à BBC as dificuldades que enfrentam em Gaza após a destruição de quase toda a infraestrutura da qual dependem.
